heading: Amasevisi le sayithi engawasebenzisa
withdrawn: Zonke izinketho zihoxisiwe. Isevisi ngayinye izophinda ibuze.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Ibala ukuvakasha namakhasi afundiwe. I-Google ithola ikheli lakho le-IP futhi ingase ifake amakhukhi.
serviceSends_youtube: Idlala amavidiyo avela ku-YouTube. I-Google ithola ikheli lakho le-IP futhi ingase ifake amakhukhi.
serviceSends_vimeo: Idlala amavidiyo avela ku-Vimeo. I-Vimeo ithola ikheli lakho le-IP; le sayithi iyayicela ukuthi ingakulandeleli.
serviceSends_google_maps: Ibonisa amamephu avela ku-Google Maps. I-Google ithola ikheli lakho le-IP futhi ingase ifake amakhukhi.
serviceSends_speech: Uma isiphequluli sakho singakwazi ukuqonda inkulumo kudivayisi yakho, izwi lakho liya kusevisi yaso yenkulumo (Google, Apple noma Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Ibonisa amakhadi amarepository nokunye okuqukethwe okuvela ku-GitHub. I-GitHub ithola ikheli lakho le-IP futhi ingase ifake amakhukhi.
serviceSends_webstatus: Ibonisa amabheji okusekelwa kweziphequluli e-Baseline avela ku-webstatus.dev, iphrojekthi ye-Google Chrome. I-Google ithola ikheli lakho le-IP.
serviceSends_aframe: Ilayisha umtapo we-A-Frame ovela ku-aframe.io ukuze ibonise izigcawu ze-3D. I-aframe.io ithola ikheli lakho le-IP.
serviceSends_embed: Ibonisa okuqukethwe okuvela ku-{host}. U-{host} uthola ikheli lakho le-IP futhi angase afake amakhukhi.
